name: gameforge-agent
description: A CodeArts-powered agent workspace for end-to-end TypeScript game engineering.

scripts.build:foundation: bun run --filter @gameforge/contracts build && bun run --filter @gameforge/simulation-core build && bun run --filter @gameforge/generator build && bun run --filter @gameforge/providers build && bun run --filter @gameforge/asset-store build && bun run --filter @gameforge/run-relay build && bun run --filter @gameforge/game-verifier build && bun run --filter @gameforge/minigame-validator build
scripts.build: bun run build:foundation && bun run --filter @gameforge/game build && bun run --filter @gameforge/workbench build && bun run --filter @gameforge/tui build && bun run --filter @gameforge/desktop build && bun run --filter @gameforge/benchmark build && bun run --filter @gameforge/bundle-budget build && bun run --filter @gameforge/opencode-plugin build && bun run --filter gameforge-douyin-devtool-extension build && bun run --filter @gameforge/integrations build && bun run --filter @gameforge/mcp-server build
scripts.check: bun run build:foundation && bun run --filter '*' check
scripts.test: bun run build:foundation && bun run --filter @gameforge/mcp-server build && bun run --filter '*' test
scripts.doctor: bun run build:foundation && bun run --filter @gameforge/mcp-server build && node packages/mcp-server/dist/doctor.js
scripts.doctor:douyin: bun run --filter @gameforge/contracts build && bun run --filter @gameforge/minigame-validator build && node packages/minigame-validator/dist/douyin-cli-doctor.js
scripts.doctor:browser: bun run --filter @gameforge/contracts build && bun run --filter @gameforge/game-verifier build && node packages/game-verifier/dist/browser-doctor.js
scripts.doctor:desktop: bun run --filter @gameforge/workbench build && bun run --filter @gameforge/desktop doctor
scripts.workbench:smoke: bun run build:foundation && bun run --filter @gameforge/workbench check && bun run --filter @gameforge/game-verifier smoke:workbench
scripts.desktop:check: bun run --filter @gameforge/desktop check && bun run --filter @gameforge/desktop test && bun run doctor:desktop
scripts.provider:smoke: bun run build:foundation && bun run --filter @gameforge/mcp-server build && node packages/mcp-server/dist/provider-smoke.js
scripts.bundle:check: bun run --filter @gameforge/game build && bun run --filter @gameforge/workbench build && bun packages/bundle-budget/src/cli.ts
scripts.dev:local: bun run --parallel dev:relay dev:game dev:workbench dev:douyin-bridge
